subject: Aligning partner integration interfaces and compliance handoff for EU pilot
messages:
From: Lars Johansen <lars.j@scandintech.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement EMEA <procurement@scandintech.com>
Date: Fri, 01 Oct 2027 09:30:00 +0200
Subject: Integration & compliance handoff for EU pilot - interface mappings + evidence needed

Hi Neha / Vanessa,

Thanks again for the call this week. As we start scoping the EU pilot, our legal and security teams need a concise list of the integration touchpoints and the concrete evidence artifacts we will need to satisfy our data residency and logging requirements. High level asks from our side: 

- Interface mappings: API endpoints, callback URLs, expected payloads and retry semantics.
- Data residency: where model inference logs and KV cache live for EU customers; retention policy.
- Audit evidence: SOC2 report, logging proof (S3/ELK examples), and any encryption-at-rest details.
- Contract language: suggested phrasing for a data residency exhibit and logging SLA.

I've attached a short requirement spreadsheet that our procurement team will use to match against your evidence. Can you confirm who from Redwood will be the technical lead and who will own DocuSign/contract coordination? We have internal timelines that aim for a signed PO by Oct 12.

Attachments: scandintech-eu-pilot-requirements.xlsx (xlsx)

Regards,
Lars
Head of Integrations
ScandinTech

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Lars Johansen <lars.j@scandintech.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 01 Oct 2027 16:12:00 +05:30
Subject: Re: Integration & compliance handoff for EU pilot - interface mappings + evidence needed

Hi Lars —

Appreciate the clear list. Quick replies and plan: 

1) Technical lead: Vanessa will be the primary for integration interface details and mapping artifacts.
2) Compliance evidence: Ben will own collecting the SOC2 + logging examples and surface any gaps.
3) Contract coordination / PO: I will be the Redwood commercial lead and will work with your Procurement contact.

Action items for Redwood (deliver by Oct 6):
- Redwood partner handoff checklist (attached).
- High-level API mapping doc with endpoints and example payloads.
- A short summary of where logs are stored for EU workloads and retention defaults.

Can we schedule a 30-min walkthrough next week (Oct 4 or 5) to go through the handoff checklist and clarify the contract exhibit language? I've added a HubSpot record (HS-78901) to track the steps.

Attachments: redwood-partner-handoff-checklist.pdf (pdf)

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Strategic Partnerships — Redwood Inference

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lars Johansen <lars.j@scandintech.com>
Date: Sat, 02 Oct 2027 11:05:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Integration & compliance handoff for EU pilot - interface mappings + evidence needed

Neha / Marcus / Lars —

Looping in Marcus (runtime/ops) to confirm the technical artifacts. Some immediate notes from my side before the walkthrough: 

- API surface: We'll provide an "integration spec" that contains the endpoints, request/response examples, and idempotency guidance. Expect ~6 endpoints for the initial pilot (ingest, status, callback, usage, metrics, revoke).
- KV cache / residency: For EU pilot we recommend pinning to our Frankfurt region pools; KV & prefix caches are scoped to tenant regional pools and are not replicated outside the region by default. That said, our streaming callbacks may still traverse control-plane endpoints. We'll document control-plane versus data-plane boundaries.
- Logging / retention: Default inference logs retained for 30 days for hosted pilots; we can extend retention for Dedicated/Private. We'll provide S3 path examples and bucket audit IDs.
- Evidence: SOC2 is available in Drive (link below). For procurement please confirm the format they need (pdf, CSV of examples, or signed attestation).

I'll sketch the integration spec and share before the call.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-RWI-partner-eu

-Vanessa
Head of Partnerships — Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Procurement EMEA <procurement@scandintech.com>, Lars Johansen <lars.j@scandintech.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 03 Oct 2027 09:48:00 +08:00
Subject: Re: Integration & compliance handoff for EU pilot - interface mappings + evidence needed

Hi Lars / Procurement team —

Attaching the regional data flow diagram and the S3 logging / escrow spec referenced on the call. A few contract-phrase suggestions we use for the "Data Residency Exhibit": 

- "Redwood will ensure that inference request payloads and persistent logs generated from subscriptions designated for the EU pilot are processed and stored exclusively within the EU region (Frankfurt region) unless Customer explicitly authorizes cross-border transfer in writing."
- "Redwood will publish bucket IDs and logging endpoints to a read-only artifact for Customer auditors and will retain logs for the agreed retention period as defined in Schedule A."

Attachments: regional-data-flow-diagram.png (image), s3-logging-escrow-spec.md (md)

DocuSign for the exhibit: https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=ef12345

If procurement needs a signed SOC2 attestation rather than the report, Ben can coordinate and provide a signed letter.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Engineering — Redwood Inference

From: Lars Johansen <lars.j@scandintech.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 04 Oct 2027 11:05:00 +02:00
Subject: Re: Integration & compliance handoff for EU pilot - interface mappings + evidence needed

Neha / Vanessa / Marcus —

Thanks — this is exactly what we needed. Procurement will start vetting the DocuSign exhibit today and I'll confirm the PO timeline after their review. For the call, Oct 5 at 09:00 CET works for our team (Mei from Kumo Consulting will join as our SI integrator).

Next steps we have on our side:
- Procurement will review the exhibit and the S3 logging spec (internal target Oct 7).
- SI (Mei) will review the integration spec during the Oct 5 walkthrough and provide a short gap list.

I'll upload a populated version of the spreadsheet and share the updated file by Oct 6.

Thanks again,
Lars
Head of Integrations
ScandinTech
